title: Localization at an element commutes with passing to a quotient
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring, $J\subseteq B$ an ideal, $b\in B$ with image $\bar b\in B/J$, and $B_b$ the localization at $\{1,b,b^2,\dots\}$. Then the ring map $B/J\to B_b/JB_b$ induced by $B\to B_b$ makes $B_b/JB_b$ a localization of $B/J$ at $\{1,\bar b,\bar b^2,\dots\}$: there is a unique ring isomorphism $(B/J)_{\bar b}\xrightarrow{\sim}B_b/JB_b$ sending $\bar x/\bar b^n$ to the class of $x/b^n$.
